sourceScenario.title: Fund and resolve the hidden coffee branch, then verify secret trial defeat through the real V3 battle

steps.description: Read authoritative initial character creation state
A new isolated test profile starts at character creation

steps.name: creation-industry
steps.description: Capture the first creation step
Choose internet industry
Allow the industry selection and any dismissed event transition to settle
Click the visible next-step button and wait for the authoritative direction state
Confirm the second creation step
Choose the available technical direction
Advance to profession and verify the authoritative wizard state
Choose Java backend profession
Advance to identity and verify the authoritative wizard state
Enter a test nickname with real keyboard input
Scroll the identity form until its save control is inside the clipped panel
Verify the identity save control is now visible and uncovered
Save identity through the creation UI
Wait for the identity form save to settle before changing the scroll region
Scroll to the background choices after saving identity
Choose a valid starting background
Wait until the real character-creation UI reflects the selected background
Confirm the chosen background is the authoritative wizard state before advancing

steps.name: creation-identity-backgrounds
steps.description: Verify the background choice through its selected UI state
Advance to destiny and verify the authoritative wizard state
Scroll the tall destiny candidate cards into the visible area
Choose a destiny candidate
Allow the selected destiny to settle before advancing
Advance to allocation and verify the authoritative wizard state
Keep the valid default allocation and verify the confirmation state
Finalize the character through the UI
Enter the game through the real onboarding control and verify its authoritative state, retrying only while still at the first story step
The onboarding action completed before dependent first-task checks
Onboarding creates its first real assigned task
Read the existing salary wallet before completing the first assigned task
Verify the real onboarding-task control is visible and unobstructed
Complete the first assigned task through its visible UI and canonical task service
The real task reward funds coffee without injecting wallet state
Defeat the first enemy with the visible attack control
Reach the first intern event milestone through visible combat
Help the intern through the visible event option
Choose the branch that unlocks the hidden coffee event
Continue the intern chain using its rendered choice
Continue the first stage toward the coffee-event milestone
Continue the first stage toward the coffee-event milestone
Reach the authored arena:1:5 hidden-event trigger
Wait for the hidden event unlocked by the prior visible story choices

steps.name: secret-trial-choice
steps.description: Capture the hidden event and its real choices before selecting
Buy coffee through its real event choice and debit the existing salary wallet
The hidden event charges the canonical wallet exactly ¥18 before opening the trial
Read the canonical run after resolving the hidden event
Start the challenge through its visible control, backed by V3 BattleService
The authoritative run must contain the actual V3 battle run ID
Open the existing project battle page from its main navigation control
Read the existing authoritative V3 battle run without mutating it
The special challenge is backed by the existing incident battle mode

steps.name: secret-trial-battle
steps.description: Capture the actual challenge boss and V3 battle controls
Use the rendered battle exit control to produce a real failed challenge result
Wait for the real critical-message choice that took priority over battle settlement
Choose the actual boss conversation option and let the game close its message modal
Read the authoritative terminal battle snapshot after dismissing the higher-priority message
The message flow must not consume or hide the actual battle result
Wait for the surfaced no-choice story event before the battle result
Resolve the real story-event acknowledgement through its visible control
Wait for the canonical story-event result acknowledgement
Acknowledge the resolved story event through the visible continue control
Wait for the real battle-abort result dialog and its explicit exit control
Acknowledge the visible abort result through its fallback UI control
Return to the existing project battle page after acknowledging the result
Read the authoritative challenge result after normal game-loop settlement
Challenge loss is recorded under its namespaced authoritative outcome flag
The settled challenge clears its active battle reference

steps.name: secret-trial-defeat
steps.description: Capture the post-settlement run state for the replay record
